text: そうそう　ポケモンを　まひ　させて　さらに　ねむらせる…　なんてことは　できないので　きをつけよう

structure.jp: ポケモンを　まひ　させて
さらに　ねむらせる…
structure.en: then also putting it to sleep...

structure.jp: なんてことは　できないので
structure.en: a thing like that can't be done, so

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means making someone or something do or be that; ねむらせる right after works the same way. まひ させて = 'making it paralyzed, and'.

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.span: ねむらせる…　なんてことは
patterns.explanation: なんてこと wraps up what was just said as 'a thing like that', a little dismissively. ねむらせる… なんてことは = 'a thing like also putting it to sleep'.

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので after a verb means 'because, so', giving the reason for what comes next. できないので = 'you can't do it, so'.
